title: Within-visit systolic–diastolic covariance adds no demonstrated albuminuria prediction benefit across two NHANES cycles
abstract: Adding signed-log systolic–diastolic covariance to mean BP, marginal BP variability and clinical covariates did not improve transferred albuminuria prediction: weighted Brier improvement -0.00001141, 95% joint PSU-bootstrap interval [-0.00019545, 0.00003354]. Independent temporal NHANES samples of 4552 and 4974 adults; negative result for the specified single-feature model.
